title: Neon Night Market
theme: a neon-lit night market food festival
music_prompt: bright upbeat synthwave, festival energy, 110 bpm, no vocals

beats.say: Tonight only. The Neon Night Market is back.
Glowing stalls, sizzling griddles, and the best street food in town.

show.prompt: a vibrant neon-lit night market food festival, glowing stalls, steam rising, people walking, cinematic, vertical

beats.say: Start with the loaded tacos. Six bucks, piled high.

show.prompt: close-up of loaded street tacos on a paper tray under warm neon light, mouthwatering, vertical

beats.say: Live music all night, right by the water.
Save room for warm churros, four dollars a basket.

show.prompt: a basket of warm cinnamon churros with chocolate dip, neon bokeh background, vertical

beats.say: Come hungry. We're down at Riverfront Park.
